outcomes.first_year_retention_entering_c.evidence: Section B22 'Retention Rates' (pages 9-10) in this 2023-2024 edition asks only for a single computed 'Enter retention rate:' box (92.2%, page 10) with no separate entering-cohort-count or still-enrolled-count input rows. Per this metric's own instructions, this count field is new in the 2025-26 CDS edition and its absence here is a template-version absence, not zero. Pages 9-10 read in full to confirm no such row exists.

outcomes.first_year_retention_still_enro.evidence: Same B22 section (pages 9-10): only the single computed retention-rate percent box is printed; no separate still-enrolled-count row exists in this edition. Per instructions, absence in a pre-2025-26 edition is template-version absence, not zero.

outcomes.first_year_retention_reported_p.evidence: B22 'Enter retention rate:' box at top of page 10, printed '92.2%'. Copied exactly as a string per instructions, not recomputed.
